name: Jamie Till
story: Jamie Till worked in Eagle Technology’s technical advisory practice and appears repeatedly in New Zealand Esri conference programmes. A 2019 agribusiness account documents him demonstrating the GIS and hive-management system built for Manuka Health, including hive locations, access routes, hazards and supply-chain traceability. His work illustrates the movement of GIS from mapping software into operational primary-industry applications.
